scope: Fifteen complete finite definitions:47 trackers,421updates,104original snapshots and21outcomes;61static/130executed assertions. Exact complete native values with reviewed JSON Number/undefined/native-map adapters; frozen pricing unchanged.

capture_method.transformations: Static imports are replaced with frozen exports/observing facades; all source helper definitions, test callback bodies and original assertion expressions remain unchanged apart from assertion counting wrappers. Full update/outcome inputs and every source snapshot are retained; additional pure snapshots after updates expose intermediate state.
adaptations: JavaScript Number values compare to native JSON numbers by exact f64 value, accepting 6 and 6.0 but no tolerance, rounding, missing keys, or array reordering.
Only own object fields whose original value is undefined are omitted for native JSON; every path is retained. No selected assertion checks own-property identity.
Plain JavaScript object prototype isolation maps to independent native JSON maps; no JavaScript prototype or ESM embedding compatibility is claimed.
Native snapshots are owned detached Values; explicit native mutation checks supplement the unchanged source callback mutations.
Snapshot reads after each update additionally expose complete intermediate state. They do not replace or remove any original source snapshot/assertion.

undefined_fields.rule: Own undefined object fields omitted at native JSON boundary and each exact path retained; no selected own-property assertion.

native_method.comparison: All original values and complete intermediate snapshots; exact f64 number equality accepts integral/floating representations with identical JavaScript Number value only. No numeric tolerance, rounding, omitted keys or reordered arrays.
native_method.inventory: Pinned SHA plus exact68cases/47trackers/21outcomes/525steps, unique IDs, per-definition counts and ordered capture-to-corpus links.
negative_cases: missing request_complete replaced by ignored event
